color.note: QATrack+ has one theme. The branch defines no CSS custom properties: every value below is the literal colour its stylesheets use, named here by role. Pairs that fall under 4.5:1 are kept exactly as the code has them and flagged in their notes.

tokens.name: chrome-bg
tokens.usage: Top navigation bar, sidebar and .bg-dark-gray (skin-black-dark). White text on it is 14.1:1.

tokens.name: chrome-bg-deep
tokens.usage: The logo block in the header, the hovered/active sidebar item and the sidebar toggle hover.

tokens.name: chrome-bg-header
tokens.usage: Sidebar section headers (.sidebar-menu > li.header).

tokens.name: chrome-bg-raised
tokens.usage: The control sidebar (right-hand user panel) background.

tokens.name: chrome-text
tokens.usage: Nav links and the logo on chrome-bg. Hovered nav items flip to black text on white.

tokens.name: chrome-text-muted
tokens.usage: Sidebar links on chrome-bg (8.1:1).

tokens.name: chrome-text-sub
tokens.usage: Sidebar sub-menu links on #2c3b41 (4.4:1, just under 4.5).

tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: The content area behind boxes (.content-wrapper).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Boxes, dropdowns, inputs, picker results.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Default button fill, input-group add-ons, .text-display panels; also the faint row divider inside boxes.

tokens.name: surface-foot
tokens.usage: The Cancel / Save footer under a box body in edit mode (.tl-group-foot).

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered table rows and picker items.

tokens.name: surface-chip
tokens.usage: Attachment chips (.tle-attach-item).

tokens.name: surface-code
tokens.usage: Fault-type code chips (.fl-code-chip).

tokens.name: surface-comment
tokens.usage: A single comment in .box-comments.

tokens.name: surface-iconbtn-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill behind a borderless icon button (.tl-iconbtn).

tokens.name: surface-pending
tokens.usage: An attachment chosen but not yet saved (.fl-pending).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The default rule: inputs, .box-default top border, table header underline, label-default fill. Too light to carry meaning alone (1.5:1 on white).

tokens.name: border-light
tokens.usage: .text-display, .drop-shadow, timeline icons and the 2px button/input shadow colour. Dropdown menus use #bbb, not this.

tokens.name: border-chip
tokens.usage: Attachment chip outline and .subheading-divider.

tokens.name: border-code
tokens.usage: Fault-type code chip outline.

tokens.name: border-dashed
tokens.usage: The dashed 'Browse…' attachment drop target.

tokens.name: border-popover
tokens.usage: Picker results panel that opens above a footer search.

tokens.name: border-editing
tokens.usage: The 1px ring around a section box while it is being edited; also the pending chip outline.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Box titles, page titles, default button text, label-default text. 9.7:1 on surface, 8.5:1 on page-bg.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Bootstrap body copy and the fault code (.fl-code). 12.6:1 on surface.

tokens.name: text-label
tokens.usage: Form field labels, dl terms and chip text. 7.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: text-desc
tokens.usage: Descriptions under a code or row (.fl-desc). 6.0:1 on surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Bootstrap .text-muted and popovers. 4.48:1 on surface: a hair under AA.

tokens.name: text-meta
tokens.usage: Timestamps, table headers (.tl-table th), pick-item subtitles, .fl-rec-label. 3.1:1 on surface: fails AA for its 11–12px uses.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Empty states, hints, help text, idle icon buttons and spinner. 2.6:1 on surface: fails AA; use for icons only where you can.

tokens.name: text-crumb
tokens.usage: Breadcrumb trail under the page title. 2.3:1 on page-bg: fails AA.

tokens.name: text-code-chip
tokens.usage: Text in a fault-type code chip, on surface-code (6.9:1).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: QATrack+'s own primary: .btn-primary, .box-primary top border, active nav-stacked edge, alert-primary. White text on it is 8.4:1.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: btn-primary hover, focus and border.

tokens.name: primary-border-hover
tokens.usage: btn-primary border on hover and focus.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: QATrack+'s .btn-info and alert/callout-info fill. White text on it is 4.8:1.

tokens.name: info-hover
tokens.usage: btn-info hover and focus.

tokens.name: info-border
tokens.usage: btn-info and alert-info border.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: .box-info top border (the default section box) and the file icon in attachment chips. 3.2:1 on surface-chip: fine for a 3px rule or icon, not for text.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links, focus border on buttons and inputs, the 'Editing' tag, .label-primary. 3.7:1 on surface and 3.2:1 on page-bg: fails AA for body-size text.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Every link on hover, active and focus (AdminLTE a:hover, no underline), including .callout-custom links.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: QC 'OK' (.ok), success label/button/callout, 'Reviewed', the '+' in pick items, the 'New' badge, 'Saved' flash. As text on white it is 3.2:1 (fails AA); white on it is also 3.2:1.

tokens.name: status-ok-hover
tokens.usage: btn-success on :hover only; its border colour never shows. Focus uses Bootstrap's #449d44.

tokens.name: status-tolerance
tokens.usage: QC 'Tolerance' (.tolerance), warning label/button, unreviewed status border, the default test status colour. White on it is 2.2:1: AdminLTE's pair fails AA.

tokens.name: status-tolerance-hover
tokens.usage: btn-warning on :hover only; its border colour never shows. Focus uses Bootstrap's #ec971f.

tokens.name: status-action
tokens.usage: QC 'Action' (.action), danger label/button/callout, required-field asterisk, error lists, .border-error. 4.1:1 as text or behind white text: under AA for body sizes.

tokens.name: status-action-hover
tokens.usage: btn-danger on :hover only; its border colour never shows. Focus uses Bootstrap's #c9302c.

tokens.name: status-no-tol
tokens.usage: QC 'No Tol Set' (.no_tol), info label and callout in stock AdminLTE. White on it is 2.2:1: fails AA.

tokens.name: status-not-done
tokens.usage: QC 'Not Done' (.not_done). qa.css sets only the background, so the label text is white (1.9:1, fails AA); black text would be 10.9:1.

tokens.name: unreviewed
tokens.usage: 'Unreviewed' text in the Record box (.fl-unrev). 3.9:1 on surface: fails AA for its 13px use.

tokens.name: danger-deep
tokens.usage: Text of the ghost danger button, the missing-file chip and the chip remove × on hover. 5.4:1 on surface, 4.6:1 on danger-ghost-bg.

tokens.name: danger-ghost-bg
tokens.usage: Hover fill of .btn-danger-ghost and of a danger icon button.

tokens.name: danger-ghost-border
tokens.usage: Declared as the resting border of .btn-danger-ghost, but never shows: .btn { border-color: transparent !important } in custom-adminlte.css wins.

tokens.name: missing-bg
tokens.usage: Attachment chip whose file is gone from the server (.fl-missing).

tokens.name: missing-border
tokens.usage: Outline of the missing-file chip.

tokens.name: comment-error
tokens.usage: A comment flagged as an error (.err-comment), with white text (3.3:1: fails AA).

tokens.name: chip-remove
tokens.usage: Resting colour of the × that removes an attachment chip.

families.sans: "Source Sans Pro", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: logo
styles.usage: The wordmark in the header: set light, with 'QAT' and '+' in <b> (700), white on chrome-bg-deep. A site's SITE_NAME replaces it.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The h1 at the top of a details page (.fl-page-head h1), in text.

styles.name: box-title
styles.usage: A box's title (.box-header .box-title), in text. It is an h3, so Bootstrap gives it weight 500, which renders with the 400 face: titles never look bold.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: A divider heading inside a box (.subheading-divider) and the title of a .box-small.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The beam was interrupted at 40 MU.
styles.usage: Default copy everywhere (Bootstrap 3 body), in text-body.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Labels, table headers, dl terms and .label: QATrack+ sets all of them to 600.

styles.name: compact
styles.usage: Text inside htmx edit sections: descriptions, search inputs, field labels at 600. Line height is inherited from body; only .tl-desc-edit sets 1.5.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines, help text (italic), breadcrumbs, field errors, pick-item subtitles, line height inherited. btn-sm is also 12px but with line height 1.5.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase column headers in .tl-table and the Record box's .fl-rec-label, in text-meta.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: The uppercase 'Editing' tag in a section header, in link.

styles.name: nav-header
styles.usage: Uppercase group headings inside nav dropdowns, #999.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: The white-on-green 'New' badge beside a fault type created in this edit.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Fault-type codes in tables and picker results (.fl-code, .tl-mono).

styles.name: pre
styles.usage: Pre-formatted values and procedure text (.pre), wrapping.

spacing.note: There is no spacing scale in the code: these are the steps the boxes and the htmx sections actually use.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a pick item's name and subtitle.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between picker results and between code chips; .box-small margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between header tools, chips and description actions.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Footer button gap (.tl-group-foot), table cell vertical padding, error list margin.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Box header and box body padding; table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Footer horizontal padding; row gap in .tl-form.

tokens.name: space-15
tokens.usage: Gap under the page header; Bootstrap gutter half-width.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between the two columns of section boxes (.fl-layout) and column gap in .tl-form.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Space under each box (.box margin-bottom).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: QATrack+ squares boxes, alerts, form controls, dropdowns, pagination and every .btn-flat.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Labels, the htmx search box and the inline description editor.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Non-flat buttons, icon buttons, chips, pick items and picker panels.

tokens.name: shadow-box
tokens.usage: Every .box.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Every .btn, flat ones included (the rule is !important, so AdminLTE's .btn-flat cannot remove it), button groups and enabled .form-control inputs: QATrack+'s hard offset shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-inline-input
tokens.usage: The htmx search box and description editor (lighter than shadow-control).

tokens.name: shadow-dropdown
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, select2 dropdowns, popovers and .drop-shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-header
tokens.usage: Under the main header bar.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Picker results that float above a section's footer.

tokens.name: shadow-editing
tokens.usage: A section box in edit mode (.fl-sec[data-editing="1"]).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Main header and logo height.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Sidebar and full logo width.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Form controls (QATrack+ trims Bootstrap's 34px).

tokens.name: iconbtn-size
tokens.usage: Width and height of .tl-iconbtn.

tokens.name: box-accent
tokens.usage: Top border that colours a .box by kind (box-info, box-primary…).

tokens.name: content-max-lg
tokens.usage: Details pages (.max-width-lg).

tokens.name: content-max-md
tokens.usage: .max-width-md, and the breakpoint where .fl-layout drops to one column.
